title: Cyrus and the Thorn
premise: Sebastian Reyes, an exiled storm-caller hiding in the Thornfell mountains, is captured by the crown's gift-hunt and forced to guide a royal expedition through smuggler's roads to the last dragon's lair. The prince leading the hunt, Alaric, believes destroying the dragon will end the old wars; Sebastian knows her own bloodline is bound to it, and that killing it will unleash the hoarded storm-magic that once shattered a continent. Falling for Alaric against every instinct of survival, she must choose between exposing her inheritance and letting the last dragon-fire gutter out. In the end she claims her power openly, spares the dragon by binding its fire to her own line, and walks away from both crown and exile to forge a third path in the mountains.
about_author: Xanthe Villalobos grew up in a mining town ringed by mountains and spent her childhood inventing storms that never came. She writes fantasy about people who inherit more trouble than treasure.

chapters.title: Salt in the Wind
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Living under a false name in a border town, she suppresses her storm-gift while running contraband over the Thornfell passes. When she instinctively calms a freak squall to save a child, a royal informant sees. Emotional beat: the cost of hiding who you are, and the first crack in her careful exile.

chapters.title: The Hunt Proclamation
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The crown posts bounties on the gifted; soldiers burn a neighbor's cottage as example. Sebastian flees into the high passes but is ambushed by a royal patrol led by Prince Alaric, who offers her a bargain: guide his expedition to the dragon's lair, or hang. Emotional beat: cornered fury and cold calculation.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Roads
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV, with interludes from Alaric's journal. She leads the column through treacherous back routes, testing their limits and planning escape, while Alaric reveals unexpected knowledge of the old wars—and doubts about his father's hunt. Emotional beat: grudging respect kindling between captor and captive.

chapters.title: What the Pass Remembers
chapters.summary: Alaric's POV. An avalanche traps the expedition; Sebastian uses her gift openly to save them, confirming what Alaric suspected. He conceals it from his zealous captain, Veyra. Emotional beat: Alaric's duty begins to fracture as he realizes the hunt may be built on lies.

chapters.title: The Ash Village
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. They pass a village destroyed generations ago by dragon-fire—or so the histories claim; Sebastian recognizes the scorch-patterns of storm-magic instead. Her grandmother's stories surface: her bloodline was bred to bind the dragon, then exiled when the crown feared them. Emotional beat: grief for erased history, dread of her inheritance.

chapters.title: Veyra's Leash
chapters.summary: Alaric's POV. Veyra discovers evidence of Sebastian's gift and demands her execution; Alaric stalls, binding himself tighter to his prisoner. Sebastian overhears and realizes the prince is now risking treason for her. Emotional beat: love against duty sharpening into open conflict within the expedition.

chapters.title: The Guttering Hearth
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. They reach the dragon's caldera and find the great wyrm dying, its fire nearly out—the true reason for the hunt's urgency. The dragon speaks to Sebastian alone, naming her bloodline and offering the choice: let it die and release its hoarded storm, or bind it and bear its burden forever. Emotional beat: awe and terrible responsibility.

chapters.title: Crown and Cinder
chapters.summary: Alaric's POV. Veyra moves to kill the dragon and Sebastian both, revealing the king intends to harvest the storm-magic as a weapon. Alaric turns his sword on his own captain; battle erupts across the caldera. Emotional beat: betrayal, sacrifice, and Alaric choosing love and truth over crown.

chapters.title: Stormbound
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Wounded and exposed before the surviving soldiers, Sebastian accepts the binding—dragon-fire fusing with her storm-gift—as Veyra falls and the hoarded magic settles harmlessly into her line. Alaric publicly renounces the hunt. Emotional beat: claiming power without being corrupted by it.

chapters.title: A Third Road
chapters.summary: Shared POV. Months later, the king's reprisal looms, but mountain clans and sympathetic soldiers rally to Sebastian and Alaric, who establish a refuge for the gifted in Thornfell. The dragon's ember lives on in her, neither weapon nor prisoner. Emotional beat: hard-won peace, love chosen freely, and a future unwritten.
